verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a memory API with a self-hostable binary, but the evidence never mentions a telemetry or usage-tracking toggle. Self-hosting claims that data never leaves the building (supermemory-docs-8) describe local data processing, an adjacent privacy feature rather than a documented opt-out of telemetry, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
